name: Grandmother’s Teeth
body:
Filed to points or naturally strong, your teeth have become weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +6, hag’s claws class ability.

Benefit(s): You gain a bite natural weapon dealing as much damage as your claw attacks. If used as part of a full attack action, the bite is made at your full base attack bonus –5.
